resource: Deterministic RNG draws (one chance draw and one quantity draw per loot-table entry) to plan one creature death
allocation_impact: Checked before any draw is made (before planning): a table needing more than 32 draws is rejected whole.
boundary_tests: max=32: a 16-entry table needs exactly 32 draws and is planned
max+1 would need 17 entries, already rejected by COMBAT01-LOOT-PLAN-ENTRIES before its 34th draw
consumers: apps/game-server/src/combat/loot_plan.rs (plan_creature_loot: entries.len() * 2 checked against 32 before any deterministic_draw call)
notes: D77, decision §4.1; evidence packet Q2 COMBAT01-LOOT-RNG-DRAWS = 2 * 16 entries. Not the same value as DUR03-RL-08 (retry/reconciliation work units, unrelated). Registered by OTV2-20260928-combat-d2a-loot-plan.
